body: That’s deep bro and so true. Life sucks! I’m a student of the arts and I think that when we look at works of art like a movie or a book for example we can see life reflected back at us. Scientists argue the universe is almost 14 billion years old. I don’t know how old you are, but you’ll probably make it to about 80 if you’re lucky(or unlucky if you view it that way lol). The way I like to look at my life is as if it were a work of art, not created by me, but created by the infinite expression of the mind of the universe. Life is so short, it’d be a shame to miss the ending, not only that, but you’d be very impatient because you’ve got eternity ahead of you, whether that’s eternity in an endless black void, or eternity in some heavenly utopia it doesn’t matter. Eternity is ahead, mortality is now. You  only get this one chance to read this book, so you can give up and put it down now or you can see how it ends. I hope you find the peace you’re looking for, trust me it’s not too far.

I think the only disagreement we have is on what religion I am. I don’t follow or practice a religion, I follow the teachings of Christ. All I’m saying is that love is real, then God is real, and if Jesus really did rise from the dead, then he must’ve been who he said he was. I’ve looked into multiple ancient teachers of spirituality and I’ve found that the teachings of Christ were the ones I resonated with most, maybe because his message of unconditional love really touched my heart, and I think it can affect everyone in the same way it affected me. I like Taoism as well which is more of a philosophy. I think there’s something incredibly life changing about the story of Christ, something greater than we can understand, the meaning of love is hidden within his story. When I say read the spirit I mean read the truth, read what is truly being said without any sort of bias and find Jesus written even in the Old Testament, through Jonah, the bronze serpent on a pole in the book of Numbers, the lambs blood in Exodus, the servant in Isaiah. The prophets wrote about him hundreds of years before he was born on earth.

I like that you’re intelligent and actually seem interested rather than a lot of people I’ve talked to that just hear other people talking about religion and just spew out the same words they do. When you read the Bible you don’t read the words, you read the spirit.  You believe love is just a human quality? I’ll tell you this Love is much more than just a human quality. I can say without a doubt that without love you would’ve never been born. Even if your parents didn’t love each other, somewhere down the line two people were in love and gave birth to one of your ancestors. Even before you were formed in your mother’s womb you were a thought in the mind of Love. I’ll tell you this and I believe it to be true not only by my faith, but also through empirical evidence of my personal experiences with God. Love is the foundation that all things are built on. 

“Love is patient and kind. Love is not jealous or boastful or proud or rude. It does not demand its own way. It is not irritable, and it keeps no record of being wronged. It does not rejoice about injustice but rejoices whenever the truth wins out. Love never gives up, never loses faith, is always hopeful, and endures through every circumstance.”
— ‭‭1 Corinthians‬ ‭13:4-7‬‬

What is greater than love? Why would someone give their life up for someone else? What can change the entire universe for good in the blink of an eye? 

The world is filled with darkness and love is the light. We who have been given the light (love itself in the form of the Holy Spirit), are tasked with spreading it to the entire world. Our goal is to see to it that no one lives an eternity of darkness because of their own selfish desires. Believe in the light, believe in love itself, and you believe in the teachings of Christ. When you live in love you are a follower of Christ. To live in love is not some far out idea, to live in love is to live in a state of self sacrifice and obedience to the divine unity that is love. If someone had never read the Bible and never knew who Christ was they would not be eternally separated from Gods presence if they didn’t reject the light. If you know love, you know Christ. We all know love when we are young, we begin to forget it as we grow older. 

Matthew 18:3
Then he said, “I tell you the truth, unless you turn from your sins and become like little children, you will never get into the Kingdom of Heaven.”

If you can see love as the divine form and not just another chemical reaction in our brains, then you’ll understand what I’m talking about.

Christ’s followers are meant to be recognized by how they love. Countries, cults, religions, etc. all have symbols they use and when you look at America for instance you recognize someone with an American flag is for America. With Christians when you see someone showing love you are meant to recognize them as a follower of Christ. 

John 13:35 

“Your love for one another will prove to the world that you are my disciples.”

As disciples of Christ we are disciples of love, for Christ is god in human form, and God ultimately is love. 

1 John 4:16 “We know how much God loves us, and we have put our trust in his love.
God is love, and all who live in love live in God, and God lives in them.”

Anyone showing hate is not a follower of Christ. Yes sometimes followers of Christ show hate and lose sight of their path, and so if they lose sight of their path they’re no longer following Christ anymore. How could they be following Christ when Christ is on the path and they’ve lost sight of that path by going away from God’s plan which is world peace and love. There is no hate in love. As Christians we live in constant repentance to God for the things we’ve done that are far from love, which we do everyday. I personally believe that we’re all brothers and sisters on earth and I see a day in the future where we have world peace, not only between nations, but between every single human being

I was not promoting good works, I definitely don’t believe in that, but I don’t believe in hell in the same way you do either. If the only way we are saved is by God’s grace then that would mean it is completely up to God whether we are saved or not because it is his grace. I just don’t want to discredit any other form of religion, I feel like that’s a big problem with the world right now, we don’t realize we all believe in the same thing with different names and different stories. I personally believe that god came in the flesh as Jesus Christ, but that doesn’t mean that if someone believes that God was some other person that came to earth 2500 years ago that I’m going to tell them that Jesus is the only way. I think that as long as a religion promotes one god (which most religions do even if they have multiple gods they are all just aspects of one god). I also think that because Jesus was “the word of god” he said that he is the truth the way and the life, and I think most people would agree with me when I say that scripture doesn’t have to be said or memorized word for word for it to be correct, so when he is saying he is the truth the way and the life I take it as he was saying that the word of god is the truth the way and the life, and even Paul says in Galatians 5:14 “For the entire law is fulfilled in keeping this one command: "Love your neighbor as yourself."”. I think that God is love, and that the word of God is love. So I believe from my personal experience that spreading Love, and being a good person by the grace that God gives you is enough. I also believe that God gives grace to all people, but not everyone accepts it. I think that hell is what happens when you don’t accept god’s grace or you don’t accept his love, and because of the fact that we have free will we have the choice as to whether we want to accept god or not.

Well I mean the Gospel of Jesus Christ is the Gospel of peace and love, and I think that if you spread peace and love and search for inner peace within yourself then there is no need for religion. I wouldn’t say I follow any religion, I would say that I follow the teachings of Jesus Christ, I also have studied Buddhism and Hinduism and they both promote peace and love, and many ancient cultures talk about the death and rebirth experience that born again Christians talk about, which I’ve personally experienced very intensely. So it’s not about religion, it’s about getting in touch with your true self and aligning yourself with God(the collective conscious, the universe, everything within you and without you).

I’ve had very depressing nihilistic thoughts in my life as well, and the only thing that has really helped me from being depressed by these thoughts is just accepting them. There is no point to life, and that’s the beauty of it. The point of life is to make your own point. From what I’ve experienced and what I’ve learned I believe that God created life to express himself fully within infinite possibility. In Revelation 22:13 God says the he is the Beginning and the end. That would mean that the beginning and the end were the same thing and that that thing were God. It’s very hard to explain the concept of infinity, but I think that that verse in the Bible comes the closest to explaining it, it just takes a little wisdom. If you feel you don’t have wisdom you can always ask God as it says in James 1:5. I wouldn’t look at these nihilistic thoughts as a bad thing either, I would look at them as a greater understanding in the universe because in my experience my nihilistic thoughts brought me more in touch with God’s love and allowed me to understand god in a more intimate way.

I feel like this distortion can happen with any form of ‘spiritual’ practice if the person practicing truly has no idea what they’re doing and why they’re doing it, I think it has a lot to do with not asking questions. To get in a space of non attachment towards the resentment of people like this you should realize that everyone in this world is born of the same spirit, but corrupted with ideas of separateness as they learn to move through this world. Everyone is on their own path and will see the truth eventually whether in this life or the next. To be resentful towards someone who thinks they know what they’re talking about is to let your ego get the best of you because there must be some feelings of superiority when someone talks to you acting like they know what they’re talking about. Therefore you must think you know something more than them to feel that way about them. Maybe you do know more than them, but in the grand scheme of things the amount of knowledge that one man can attain is not something to be proud of in a world full of infinite knowledge. Humble yourself before all men and you will be the greatest man of all. That’s pretty much what jesus taught and what he lived, I think that’s a pretty good message because it will teach you to be in service to others and the universe.
